posts.title: The Invisible Layer
posts.description: *On the layer of craft you can't see.*

posts.title: The agent-to-agent organization
posts.description: Right now, AI agents help individuals become more productive. But the real shift happens when agents interact with each other on behalf of their owners — handling the coordination overhead that makes organizations slow despite being full of capable people.

posts.title: Product feedback — problems vs solutions
posts.description: When providing feedback to a product team, it’s infinitely more helpful to communicate *problems* rather than *solutions*.
